purpose: Isolate the unchanged native-rate publication wrapper and queue without the motor, voltage predictor or SMO/PLL graph. No full-model performance case can be closed by this probe.
source_binding: Original wrapper and all existing sensorless MATLAB sources copied with SHA256 before execution; verify unchanged afterward. No production equation or parameter edits.

fixture.quality: Synthetic false before50ms and until30ms after each fault's healthy reference. This is a fixture, not the real599-sample SMO/PLL qualification.
fixture.release_jitter: 1us for captures whose reference is at or after0.7s

checks: Exactly12800001 audit calls and15995 publications; exact independent integer capture/completion ticks and sequence numbers, including reset publication and excluding exactly5 missing captures
Every native call checks finite outputs, epoch0/1/2, no forbidden control values while denied, and permitted present-time angle prediction against the independent fixture angle within1e-10rad
The first native call at each fault onset must revoke permission and carry the registered missing/reset reason bit; permit exists before faults and returns after fixture qualification
Archive every publication, PWM heartbeat and fault onset with all output values; bounded counter log includes final endpoint; original model and frozen R1 files unchanged
execution_policy: One execution only. Retain failure/source/exit report; no changing labels to repeat. Do not start while a full-model simulation is active.
boundary: Synthetic queue scheduling/execution isolation only; no physical estimator, voltage reconstruction, ADC frontend, real599-sample lock recovery, MCU WCET or R2 performance claim. No feedback takeover and no original SLX save.
